title: Esophagus or stomach cancer
summary: Cancer of the esophagus or stomach. Esophageal cancer at any stage qualifies. Gastric cancer with inoperable/unresectable disease, recurrence, or metastases qualifies.

children.criterion: Carcinoma or sarcoma of the esophagus, at any stage
Stomach cancer that is inoperable, unresectable, extending to surrounding structures, recurrent, OR with distant metastases
